theorems.name: Submission.imc_ae_zero_density_off_set
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (S : Set (Eucl Q)) (g : Eucl Q → ℝ≥0∞), NullMeasurableSet S (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → ∫⁻ x in S ∩ K, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) < ∞) → ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)), y ∉ S → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in S ∩ closedBall y ρ, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
